entradas.text: Lucian and I walked into my office in the Maroon Palace to make my Address to the Nation speech.
"Yes. Let's do it."
entradas.menu: "Yes. Let's do it."

entradas.text: "Are you ready, sir?"
It was unusually crowded today. Cameras, lights and microphones were set in place and the crew was standing by, ready to start filming.
"I am always ready."
entradas.menu: "I am always ready."

entradas.text: "I guess."
entradas.menu: "I guess."

entradas.text: "Good. I think the crew is ready. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live."
"I'm sure you are, sir. As soon as you take your seat, we can go live. The crew is ready."
I took my seat and rearranged my notes on the desk as a crew member powdered my face with a cotton puff.
After everybody was ready, the director gave the sign to start filming. I looked directly into the camera.
"Brothers and sisters..."
entradas.menu: "Brothers and sisters..."

entradas.text: "My fellow Sords..."
entradas.menu: "My fellow Sords..."

entradas.text: "My fellow citizens..."
entradas.menu: "My fellow citizens..."

entradas.text: "I am grateful to earn the honor of finally modifying the Constitution of Tarquin Soll."
entradas.menu: "I am grateful to earn the honor of finally modifying the Constitution of Tarquin Soll."

entradas.text: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."
entradas.menu: "I'd like to speak about our future, about a great historic effort to give the words 'freedom,' 'fairness,' and 'hope' new meaning and power."

entradas.text: "I am happy to have this opportunity to talk to you about the changes we have undertaken in Sordland."
entradas.menu: "I am happy to have this opportunity to talk to you about the changes we have undertaken in Sordland."

entradas.text: "We have reached a turning point in Sordland's history."
entradas.menu: "We have reached a turning point in Sordland's history."

entradas.text: "I am proud of what our government has accomplished. We have finally brought fairness and balance to our once-decrepit system."
entradas.menu: "I am proud of what our government has accomplished. We have finally brought fairness and balance to our once-decrepit system."

entradas.text: "Two years ago, I spoke to you of change, and we have accomplished that."
entradas.menu: "Two years ago, I spoke to you of change, and we have accomplished that."

entradas.text: "We need to remember where Sordland was two years ago. Those days are behind us now, and the change we brought has been real."
entradas.menu: "We need to remember where Sordland was two years ago. Those days are behind us now, and the change we brought has been real."

entradas.text: "But in another sense, our change is a continuation of that which started three decades ago with the fall of monarchy."
entradas.menu: "But in another sense, our change is a continuation of that which started three decades ago with the fall of monarchy."

entradas.text: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Democracy."
entradas.menu: "Our new Constitution is a second revolution in the history of Sordland that truly transforms the course of government with just one word: Democracy."

entradas.text: "The new system brings a more transparent democracy that will help Sordland rise up in the world."
entradas.menu: "The new system brings a more transparent democracy that will help Sordland rise up in the world."

entradas.text: "For the sake of fairness, simplicity, and growth, we had to radically change the structure of our government system."
entradas.menu: "For the sake of fairness, simplicity, and growth, we had to radically change the structure of our government system."

entradas.text: "We made a Constitution that no longer protects the rights of a select few elites, but ensures the participation of all."

entradas.text: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and fair for all."
entradas.menu: "We transformed a system that had caused endless confusion and resentment into one that is clear, simple, and fair for all."

entradas.text: "We will not rest until every Sordish citizen enjoys the freedom, dignity, and opportunity that is our birthright."
entradas.menu: "We will not rest until every Sordish citizen enjoys the freedom, dignity, and opportunity that is our birthright."

entradas.text: "With our reforms complete, our government will now focus on the economic development of Sordland."
entradas.menu: "With our reforms complete, our government will now focus on the economic development of Sordland."

entradas.text: "Now, we have other challenges ahead. We will be focusing on Sordland's internal and external threats."
entradas.menu: "Now, we have our next challenges. We will be focusing on Sordland's internal and external threats."

entradas.text: I paused to take a deep breath.
"Next, we must transition into the parliamentary system."
entradas.menu: "Next, we must transition into the parliamentary system."

entradas.text: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people."
entradas.menu: "Henceforth, our government shall no longer be able to obstruct the will of the people."

entradas.text: "I've spoken with and received letters from thousands of you. I know how hungry you were for change. Make no mistake. Together, we can change Sordland forever."
entradas.menu: "I've spoken with and received letters from thousands of you. I know how hungry you were for change. Make no mistake. Together, we can change Sordland forever."

entradas.text: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as the democratization of Sordland because they close loopholes that benefit a privileged few."
entradas.menu: "By now I'm sure you have one question on your minds: Will our reforms help you? You bet they will. We see them as the democratization of Sordland because they close loopholes that benefit a privileged few."

entradas.text: "New term limits will ensure that no single person can block change when it's most needed."
entradas.menu: "New term limits will ensure that no single person can block change when it's most needed."

entradas.text: "We now ensure that neither I nor any other person who holds the position of president will pose the risk of ruling by decree."
entradas.menu: "We now ensure that neither I nor any other person who holds the position of president will pose the risk of ruling by decree."

entradas.text: "We eliminated the Supreme Court's iron grip on our legislation."
entradas.menu: "We eliminated the Supreme Court's iron grip on our legislation."

entradas.text: "A new age is upon us!"
entradas.menu: "A new age is upon us!"

entradas.text: "I stand proud to have exchanged my own powers for a better future. Presidential decrees are now a thing of the past."
entradas.menu: "I stand proud to have exchanged my own powers for a better future. Presidential decrees are now a thing of the past."

entradas.text: "I will personally make sure that every change is respected and executed properly."
entradas.menu: "I will personally make sure that every change is respected and executed properly."

entradas.text: "Beyond this, we intend to strengthen the democratic freedoms of every Sordish citizen."
entradas.menu: "Beyond this, we intend to strengthen the democratic freedoms of every Sordish citizen."

entradas.text: "I must thank the Supreme Court Justices for supporting these much-needed changes."
entradas.menu: "I must thank the Supreme Court Justices for supporting these much-needed changes."

entradas.text: "For too long, our Supreme Court has acted on behalf of sinister deep state interests. That ends from now on."
entradas.menu: "For too long, our Supreme Court has acted on behalf of sinister deep state interests. That ends from now on."

entradas.text: "By abolishing the position of Member of Honor, we have ensured that Sordland will no longer be a slave to its past."
entradas.menu: "By abolishing the position of Member of Honor, we have ensured that Sordland will no longer be a slave to its past."

entradas.text: "I promise you. We will not stop."
entradas.menu: "I promise you. We will not stop."

entradas.text: "We have also lowered our unfair election threshold. No longer will the voices of the minority be silenced."
entradas.menu: "We have also lowered our unfair election threshold. No longer will the voices of the minority be silenced."

entradas.text: "We did all of this in a time of economic stress and despite heavy protests."
entradas.menu: "We did all of this in a time of economic stress and despite heavy protests."

entradas.text: "Voices were raised saying that we had to look to our past for greatness and glory. We proved, and will continue to prove them wrong."

entradas.text: "The new changes in our system have planted the seeds for untold future successes."

entradas.text: "We will open the way for Tarquin Soll's trial. He must answer for the crimes committed during his decades-long rule."

entradas.text: "We are creating a nation once again vibrant, robust, and alive."

entradas.text: "But we, the present-day Sords, are not given to looking backward. In this blessed land, there is always a better tomorrow."

entradas.text: "It is time to renew our faith in our system."

entradas.text: "Fellow citizens of Sordland, let me assure you, our nation is poised for greatness."

entradas.text: "Today, we must do what we know is right, and do it with all of our might."
entradas.menu: "Today, we must do what we know is right, and do it with all of our might."

entradas.text: "Let history say of us: these were the golden years when Sordish Democracy was reborn, when Sordland reached for her best."

entradas.text: "I'll remind you of the revolutionary phrase: 'Morning will come, Victory is close.' I am now glad to say that morning has finally come."
